definitions.explanation: Attaches to the masu-stem of a verb to indicate that the action has been completed in its entirety. Emphasizes that the process reached its endpoint.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧{終|お}わる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{遊|あそ}べない→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I can't play until I finish writing my homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、{片|かた}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めましょう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Once everyone has finished eating, let's start cleaning up.

notes:
FORMS:
Attaches to the masu-stem (⟦{連用形|れんようけい}→連用形：16646_renyoukei⟧) of verbs:
- ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ → ⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧ + {終|お}わる → ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧{終|お}わる
- ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ + {終|お}わる → ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{終|お}わる
- ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ → し + {終|お}わる → し{終|お}わる

The compound conjugates as a godan verb ({終|お}わる).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ～{終|お}わる vs. ～⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧: ～⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧ is transitive (the subject deliberately completes an action), while ～{終|お}わる is intransitive (the action comes to completion). ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧ emphasizes the reader's agency; ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ simply states that the reading is done.
- ～{終|お}わる vs. ～⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: ～⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ indicates completion with a nuance of something being finished and ready (⟦{出来|でき}{上|あ}がる→出来上がる：10407_dekiagaru⟧, to be completed/finished).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧{終|お}わる (finish reading)
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{終|お}わる (finish eating)
- ⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧{終|お}わる (finish writing)
- ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{終|お}わる (finish using)
